# Datamining: New collectors & collectors (Burning Springs PTS Update October 2, 2025)

![Datamining: New Collectors & Collectron (Burning Springs PTS Update October 2nd, 2025)](/uploads/565_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The Burning Springs PTS is now available and many new interesting items and changes are already visible via data mining. The first thing I will introduce to you here are new collectors and a new collector.

## Amm-O-Matic

Interval: 10m 12sec

Description:

Less crafting, more blasting. Generate ammo over time with the Amm-O-Matic.

This item cannot be built inside of a shelter.

Collects:

- 10mm (6-10)
- .38 Round (5-7)
- .308 Round (3-6)
- .45 Round (15-17)
- Shotgun Shell (4-8)
- .50 Round (3-7)
- .44 Round (4-8)
- 5mm Round (23-26)
- 5.56 Rounds (3-7)

## Barrel of toxic slime

Interval: 30m

Description:

None currently

Collects:

- Toxic mucus

## Pumpkin pie

Interval: 10m 12sec

Description:

Gather round for a slice of the pie! 

This item cannot be built inside of a shelter.

Collects:

- Pumpkin Pie Piece*+3.6 TP, +12 AP (25 sec) +3 CHA (1h 30 min)*

## Wall oven

Interval: 10m 12sec

Description:

With the Wall-mounted Oven, it's meat time, all the time.

- Collects Meat over time -

Collects:

- Mongrel Dog Meat
- Iguana Bits
- Mole Rat Meat
- Radroach Meat
- Squirrel Bits
- Brahmin Meat
- Radstag Meat
- Raw Wolf Meat
- Chicken thighs
- Mutant Hound Meat
-Fox Meat

## Toxic Bob

Interval: 10m 12sec

Description:

Let this collectron gather some of that toxic stuff you'd rather not touch. 

This item cannot be built inside of a shelter.

Collects:

- Toxic mucus
- Dirty water
- Glowing Blood Pack
